endpoints.description: Parse and execute a known command without sending it to the model. A resolved command's lifecycle is logged: `command/run` is appended before the handler is invoked and `command/done` after settlement (a thrown or aborted handler settles as `kind: 'error'`). Both are direct log-only appends — no turn wraps them, and persistence drains them at ordinary checkpoints. Admission misses (syntax or unknown name) log nothing — they never entered a handler. A `command/run` append failure fails the execution loud; a `command/done` append failure on the handler-failure path is contained so the handler's own error stays the reported failure. Attachment admission is enforced here, not in the composer: attachments sent to a command that does not declare `input.attachments`, an absent attachment store, and an exceeded image limit each settle as an error result before the handler runs. Validation rejection starts no attachment writes; a storage failure can leave only unreachable content-addressed objects for deferred collection.

endpoints.description: Delete every ended Host task, leaving active tasks armed. Ended tasks never schedule another delivery, so the removal changes no pending target and no timer is recomputed. Rows are enumerated and removed in one FIFO slot, so a delivery ordered behind this call ends its task after the enumeration rather than during it. The batch is one domain write: a normal failure rejects with every listed row still stored, while a backend `unknown-state` failure may have removed rows and quarantines the Host domain, so later schedule operations reject until the domain is reopened. A successful nonempty batch emits `schedule/changed` without Agent notices. A rejected batch announces `schedule/changed` because it does not establish which rows landed, and clients then re-read the catalog.

callId.description: Id of the logged tool call.

turn.description: Turn whose answer the card follows.

action.description: Registered action kind named by the call.

brief.description: What the action does, in the user's language.

details.description: Fields the kind's skill asks for.

data.description: Kind-defined fields such as a chosen location or a created package.

actionCards.description: Action card proposals and decisions for the currently open Session.

agentPreset.description: Preset the Session runs, or null when the deployment composes none.

title.description: The session's current normalized title — the latest `session/title` event's text (last-wins), or `null` before the first title lands. A plain string: the shape the client list rows consume.

content.description: What this task is — a short imperative line shown in the UI.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `in_progress` marks a task being worked now; parallel work may mark several.

todos.description: The agent's current whole todo list (the latest `todo/write` snapshot), or `null` before the first write. Whole-value rule: every `todo/write` carries the complete replacement list, so the fold is last-wins. Excluded from Session summary payloads, with `null` kept outside the exclusion mark so the pre-first-write value stays expressible.

blank.description: Whether the folded prefix contains no turn.

lastPromptAt.description: Latest human-authored prompt time in the folded prefix.

sessionListMetadata.description: Persisted facts used to summarize a Session without activating it.

maxImageDimension.description: Maximum intrinsic width and maximum intrinsic height in pixels for one image.

imageLimits.description: Image-intake limits enforced by the Session prompt endpoint. Boot constant, excluded from Session summary payloads: every Session shares it, so a list row would repeat one host-wide fact.

workingDirectory.description: Recorded current directory for Session observations, or null when none is recorded.

currentValue.description: The effective current value: a configured preset key, `auto`, or `custom`.

permissions.description: The session's current permission, folded from the three whole-value knob events (`permission/preset`, `sandbox/mode`, `approval/policy`) over the composition defaults. Selectable options come from the process-level catalog Remote. Key absence means no permission service is composed — clients hide the control.

subagentCatalog.description: Direct children in parent catalog event order, excluding fork-inherited facts.

settledMs.description: Milliseconds accumulated across completed turns after the child's own descriptor.

through.description: Latest event time folded into this projection cut.

active.description: Same-cut bounds of the currently open turn, when one has not reached `turn/end`.

lastTurnCompleted.description: Whether the latest closed turn after the child's own descriptor completed normally; absent while a turn is open or before one closes.

subagentTiming.description: Active-turn duration and latest closed-turn completion for a descriptor-backed subagent session.

label.description: Optional durable creation label from the child's descriptor.

seq.description: Seq of the `subagent/descriptor` event this identity was folded from. `session.isOwnSeq(seq)` proves the identity comes from the child's OWN log suffix — where a descriptor is immutable once appended — and not from a fork seed's replayed ancestor descriptor.

label.description: Durable creation label from the child's descriptor.
